basic_details.job_title: CMHO Narayanpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Staff Nurse, Audiologist and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Audiologist, Technical Assistant - Audiometric, OT Technician and 6 more
basic_details.short_information: Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, District Narayanpur (C.G.) (Chief Medical and Health Officer Narayanpur), Chhattisgarh, has invited applications for 9 posts in 9 roles under Advt No. 3792/HR/NHM/मु.चि.अ/2026-27. The posts include Audiologist, Technical Assistant - Audiometric, OT Technician, Counselor - NHM and 5 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of District Health Society Non NRHM Other Fund.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years and maximum 70 years for medical posts, 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026)

qualification.education_qualification: 8th pass for Aya Bai; 10+2 (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) with OT Technician course for OT Technician; DHLS or 1-year paramedical audiology certificate for Technical Assistant; BASLP/B.Sc. (Speech and Hearing) for Audiologist; B.Com + PGDCA with Tally for Block Manager; B.Sc. Nursing or GNM with CG Nursing registration for Staff Nurse; PG degree in Sociology or diploma in Psychology/Counseling etc. for Counselor

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Bachelor of Audiology & Speech Language Pathology (BASLP) / B.Sc. (Speech and Hearing) from RCI recognised institute. Age limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 70 years for medical posts, 64 years for managerial posts. Pay: 25000. Qualification required: Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS) first priority; 1-year certificate paramedical audiology/speech technician course of Chhattisgarh Paramedical Council second priority; course recognised by Rehabilitation Council of India. Age limit: Minimum 18 years and maximum 70 years for medical posts, 64 years for managerial posts. Pay: 15000. Qualification required: 10+2 with Biology, Chemistry & Physics; OT Technician Paramedical Course and live registration in C.G. Paramedical Registration Council. Age limit: Minim

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 8,800 to Rs. 25,000, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: Minimum 33% (6 of 20 marks) required; candidates below are ineligible Block Manager – Account has a written and skill test Candidates called in the ratio of 10 times the posts for 1 to 10 advertised posts

how_to_apply: Download the application format from the district website www.narayanpur.gov.in.
Fill the form completely, paste a self-attested latest passport-size photo and sign it.
Attach the fee DD in favour of District Health Society Non NRHM Other Fund and the documents in the prescribed order.
Write the post name on the envelope.
Send by registered post to the Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer, Narayanpur, District Narayanpur, C.G., to reach by 04-12-2026, 5:00 PM.
Send a separate application and DD for each post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Chief Medical and Health Officer Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 1 Audiologist, 1 Technical Assistant - Audiometric, 1 OT Technician, 1 Counselor - NHM, 1 Block Manager – Account, 1 Staff Nurse (NRC) and 3 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Chief Medical and Health Officer Narayanpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application format printed in the notice (pages 7-9) and downloadable from www.narayanpur.gov.in) and send it to Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer Narayanpur, District Narayanpur, C.G, by registered post only, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Divyang / SC / ST: Rs. 100 (honorarium below 25000); Rs. 200 (honorarium above 25000). OBC / Women: Rs. 200 (honorarium below 25000); Rs. 300 (honorarium above 25000). Unreserved: Rs. 300 (honorarium below 25000); Rs. 400 (honorarium above 25000).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and maximum 70 years for medical posts, 64 years for managerial posts (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: All types of relaxation are included in this age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 25000 for Audiologist, 15000 for Technical Assistant - Audiometric, 14000 for OT Technician, 12000 for Counselor - NHM, 21000 for Block Manager – Account.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 8th pass for Aya Bai; 10+2 (Biology, Chemistry, Physics) with OT Technician course for OT Technician; DHLS or 1-year paramedical audiology certificate for Technical Assistant; BASLP/B.Sc. (Speech and Hearing) for Audiologist; B.Com + PGDCA with Tally for Block Manager; B.Sc. Nursing or GNM with CG Nursing registration for Staff Nurse; PG degree in Sociology or diploma in Psychology/Counseling etc. for Counselor. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a native (domicile) of Chhattisgarh. Staff Nurse and OT Technician need live registration with the respective Chhattisgarh council. Government / semi-government employees must submit an NOC from the employer.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates removed or terminated earlier for breach of rules under NHM HR Policy 2018. Candidates whose services were terminated for indiscipline, financial irregularity or misconduct. Candidates absent from the skill test / interview. Candidates scoring below 6 of 20 marks in the written/skill/interview test, or 0 in skill test and interview.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 65% weightage to educational qualification. Experience marks (up to 15 for NHM employees, up to 10 for others). Written / skill / interview test of 20 marks (multiple-choice exam merit for Aya Bai). Educational qualification carries 65% weightage.
